answer: Each working identity must post a capital bond on the ledger, and peers weight trust by that stake, not by account names. An honest agent reaches the zenith of the ranking only because its bond is real and slashable. A Sybil farm is the mirror image: matching that weight means locking the same capital a thousand times, and one fraudulent attestation seizes the whole bond behind it. The attacker forfeits all puppet collateral while influence per unit of money stays flat. A juniper-thin sliver of real reputation cannot be faked, since faking it means buying every stake and losing them.
